content.title: Is Whole Foods open on Easter 2025? What to know about Easter Sunday store hours
content.text: Easter has officially arrived! Landing on Sunday, April 20, this year, it's one of the holiest holidays on the Christian calendar. For many people, it's a day for worship and gathering with loved ones for a meal. And for kids? Well, it's all about a visit from the Easter Bunny, who delivers baskets full of chocolate eggs and other seasonal treats.If Peter Cottontail forgot a few items or if you need milk, green beans or other essentials for Easter brunch, a trip to Whole Foods might be on your to-do list. Given that many grocers are closed in observance of the holiday (including Aldi, Costco and Target), you may be wondering if Whole Foods is open this Sunday and, if so, what the grocery chain's Easter hours are in 2025. To ensure you have the latest up-to-date information, TODAY.com reached out to Whole Foods for all the details on Easter 2025. After all, the April holiday comes but once a year and you don't want to spend it chasing down open stores when you'd rather enjoy the day with friends and family or plan to kick back and enjoy some springtime weather instead. Plus, there's nothing more disappointing than pulling into the parking lot of your favorite retailer only to discover that doors are locked.Find everything you need to guarantee that this year's Easter celebration is a hopping success below. Is Whole Foods open on Easter 2025?According to a Whole Foods spokesperson, this Easter, most Whole Foods Market stores will open at their regular time and close early at 6 p.m. with a few exceptions.Though a majority of stores will be open for business, the spokesperson recommends confirming local store hours using the Whole Foods store locater, which you can find right here.
